label: rem:radial-projection
title: Radial projection of Bring's surface
html: We restrict a Briggs--Klein affine chart (Briggs--Klein chart) to the interval r\in(0,1) and project Bring's surface onto this radial coordinate. This yields a fibration over the base manifold M with trivial bundle \mathcal{S}=\mathcal{S}_0. At each r, the coordinate w_1 restricts to a circle of radius \sqrt{r} in the complex plane \mathbb{C}_{w_1}. This circle constitutes the orbit of the C_5 symmetry: the rotation w_1\mapsto\zeta w_1 moves the point along this circle without altering r.
